notes: Notion database Amazon Rules is the source of truth.
This file is an export used by the optional amazon-rules engine.
Official text rules only. No photo or image rules, and no extra house rules.

rules.rule: Creating, editing, or removing a review in exchange for compensation is not allowed.
rules.pattern: (?i)\b(?:gift\s*card|in exchange for (?:this |a )?review|paid me to (?:review|write)|refund (?:if|to) (?:I |you )?(?:change|remove|update) (?:my |the )?review|free product from the seller|discount for (?:leaving|posting|writing) a review|they(?:'| a)?ll refund me if I (?:change|remove)|warranty (?:if|after) I (?:leave|post) a review)\b
rules.source_quote: Create, edit, or remove a review in exchange for compensation, including payments, refunds, discounts, products, gift cards, warranties, or services. This policy applies even if a seller offers a refund to remove or change a negative review.

rules.rule: Medical claims about preventing or curing serious conditions or severe symptoms are not allowed.
rules.source_quote: We don't allow any statements or claims related to preventing or curing serious medical conditions or severe symptoms. This policy applies to all products, including foods, beverages, supplements, cosmetics, and personal care/general products.

rules.rule: Profanity, obscenities, name-calling, or personal attacks are not allowed.
rules.source_quote: It's OK to question beliefs and expertise, but be respectful. We don't allow: Profanity, obscenities, or name-calling; Harassment or threats; Attacks on people you disagree with; Libel, defamation, or inflammatory content.

rules.rule: Reviews that only focus on seller service, shipping, or packaging are not allowed.
rules.pattern: (?i)\b(?:seller(?:'s)? (?:service|customer service|shipping)|shipping was (?:slow|fast|late)|arrived damaged|damaged in (?:transit|shipping)|packaging was (?:poor|terrible)|order (?:never arrived|was late)|return(?:ed|ing)? (?:it )?because of (?:the )?seller)\b
rules.source_quote: We don't allow reviews or questions and answers that only focus on: Sellers and the Customer Service they provide; Ordering issues and returns; Shipping packaging; Product condition and damage; Shipping cost and speed.

rules.rule: Authors must inform KDP of AI-generated content (text, images, or translations) when publishing or republishing.
rules.source_quote: We require you to inform us of AI-generated content (text, images, or translations) when you publish a new book or make edits to and republish an existing book through KDP. AI-generated images include cover and interior images and artwork. We define AI-generated content as text, images, or translations created by an AI-based tool. If you used an AI-based tool to create the actual content (whether text, images, or translations), it is considered "AI-generated," even if you applied substantial edits afterwards.

rules.rule: Paperback trim must be a size listed in official KDP Help.
rules.source_quote: You can choose from a variety of trim sizes to set the size of your printed book. The most common trim size for paperbacks in the U.S. is 6 x 9 inches (152.4 x 228.6 mm) and is a regular trim size. 8.5" x 11" (21.59 x 27.94 cm) is listed as a large trim size.
